topic: FUT card-wall shooting challenge: Celine Dept vs Michelle, each ball hits a player card that goes into their FC lineup; compare team ratings
hero: Hosts (Celine Dept, other creators) / unidentified men and women
hero_role: hosts and competitors of the challenge
hook: Presenter's kick draws yellow trail on a card-covered goalpost, with formation graphic on screen
subtitle_style: bold white graphic labels; rating numbers in coloured boxes; YouTuber lower-thirds
reaction_overlays: picture-in-picture reaction cams, REPLAY tags, card pop-ups, comedic reactions
transition_summary: Fast cuts ~1 per 2-3 s; whip/zoom graphics; replay inserts
audio_note: Host voice-over and chat (transcript: 'whatever card Celine and Michelle hit they will get for their team')

reuse_segments.how_to_reuse: recreate format with own cards/graphics (FC card likenesses carry licence risk)
